closed_notes.conclusion: 0x007DA060 is byte 0 of a 5-byte mount-state block stored in the session object 0x00777698 at offset +0x629C8 (0x777698+0x629C8 == 0x7DA060). The block layout is byte0 state (0x007DA060), word (0x007DA061-62), word/byte (0x007DA063-64). The ONLY static writer of the block is session virtual 0x0040F420 (vtable slot at 0x00476508; wrapper 0x0040FED0 at 0x004765CC): lea eax,[esi+0x629C8] at 0x0040F43A, mov dword[ecx],edx + mov byte[ecx+4],dl at 0x0040F442/0x0040F448 with this=0x777698 at every call site (0x41F5DB/0x41F680). The state byte is clamped to 0..3 by cmp byte[eax],4; jb; mov byte[eax],0 at 0x0040F46D-0x0040F472 - a 2-bit enum, not a bitmask. Click dispatch 0x00426A80 uses it as a gate: ==0 allows the Frame 860/861 button (+0x108) to dispatch @上马; !=0 allows Frame 862/863 (+0x1BC) to dispatch @遛马. The packet path (dispatcher 0x0041F1CF, case 0x267 at 0x41F597 / case 0x26B at 0x41F666) reads the block and re-sends it via 0x40F420 (echo to server); case 0x267 also writes the two word fields from packet input. The state byte additionally selects a per-state animation table entry at 0x5600FC with stride 324 (lea eax,[eax+eax*8]; lea edx,[eax+eax*8]; lea eax,[edx*4+0x5600FC] at 0x40F583-0x40F590 and 0x40F5A8-0x40F5B9) stored at session +0x62A10/+0x62A14 - the mounted appearance data, outside the window. Overlay question: NO overlay exists on the horse window itself (paint 0x4269C0 has no mount-block reference; window-manager paint dispatch at 0x428252 adds none). A state-dependent HUD draw does exist OUTSIDE the horse Paint routine, on the main game window: main-window paint segment 0x44B560-0x44B6AF reads word[0x007DA063] at 0x0044B666 and passes it as an argument to draw call 0x0045FD50 with this=0x008AB7A8 (main game window), gated by byte[0x777723] (1..10) and icon index byte[0x777720] - i.e. a mount-state-dependent HUD/dock icon on the main window, not a horse-window overlay. This closes the pending item.

closed_notes.conclusion: Mounted-appearance element binding CLOSED primary-static. Element table base 0x5600FC, element N = 0x5600FC + N*0x144 (stride 324). Mount element = element 87 = 0x566F18 = 0x5600FC + 0x57*0x144, selected NOT by the state value itself but by a hardcoded selector byte: writer 0x40F420 (and sibling 0x40C78C) stores byte [esi+0x629CF]=0x57 whenever state byte [esi+0x629C8]=0x7DA060 != 0 (0x40F47F / 0x40C79C), and the lea chain at 0x40F5A6-0x40F5C0 (lea [eax+eax*8]; lea [eax+eax*8]; lea [edx*4+0x5600FC] = x9 x9 x4 = x324) stores [esi+0x62A14] = 0x566F18. Element 87 binds to WIL path slot 17 = '.\\Data\\Horse.wil' (string 0x47CC94 copied to owner+0x1098C at 0x4538CB-0x4538E5; element-manager loop2 0x452AF7-0x452B0E binds elements 70..139 to slots 0..69, element 87 = 70+17). Consumption: world-render function 0x40F5F0 (ret 0x14, 5 args) gates on state!=0 && [esi+0x62A14]!=0 && byte[esi+0xC0]>=0x1D (0x40FA67-0x40FA96), then 0x466130(ecx=mount element, frame=0x2710+(A%400), A=[629C8]*400-[8A]*3000+[C4]-0xAA0 stored [esi+0x62A20]) at 0x40F6D7-0x40F6E9, drawing the mounted sprite in 3D world space via 0x461ED0 (ebp!=0) or 0x463330/0x460240 (ebp==0) at 0x40FAEE-0x40FB57 using frame record [element+0x38] and pixel data [element+0x3C]. Separate HUD mount icon (main-window, 0x44B560-0x44B6AF) uses element 86 = 0x566DD4 (ProgUse.wil, slot 16), frame = byte[0x777720]*10 + byte[0x777723] + 0x3B, blitted via 0x45FD50 with arg6 = word[0x7DA063] and arg7 = 0xffff; CORRECTION to Finding 255's reading: 0x45FD50's arg6/arg7 are 16-bit RLE fill colors (op 0xC2 fills with arg6, op 0xC3 with arg7, RGB-decomposed via masks [ebx+0x6C/70/74] and shifts [ebx+0x67/68/69]) - word[0x7DA063] is a fill color, NOT a frame index (all 22 other 0x45FD50 callers pass 0xffff/0xffff; the only 0x7DA063 consumers in the whole binary are 0x41F5BD packet write and 0x44B669 HUD blit). 0x430A40 flag dispatch (flag0->el82=0x5668C4, flag1->el83=0x566A08, flag2->el139=0x56B0E8) is unrelated to the mount element (it serves the status-window el82/83/139 family per Finding 246).

closed_notes.notes: imm32 scan of all 0x5600FC+0x144k (k=0..160) shows NO direct reference to 0x566F18 - the mount element is reached only through the computed [esi+0x62A14] pointer, so earlier full-VA scans of stride-324 addresses correctly found only 13 slots with imm32 refs. Element 87 itself is never an imm32 operand. The state value (1/2/3) does NOT index the element table; it only gates the hardcoded selector byte 0x57, so per-value sub-state appearance differences cannot be derived from the element binding (runtime-only).

closed_notes.conclusion: Both pending items are closed at the primary-static level by Finding 292 (horse-window-state-evidence.json). State byte0 at 0x7DA060 is a 2-bit clamp enum 0..3 (0 = not mounted, clamped at 0x40F46D-0x40F472 and 0x40C78A-0x40C78F); nonzero gates the '@遛马' branch (0x426AE2), pose action 0x1D (0x40F3CD), the world-render mount draw (0x40F662) and scales the mount animation frame by state*400 (0x40F6D7). Packet cases 0x267/0x26B preserve byte0 (0x41F5C8-0x41F5D8) - state transitions originate from session virtual 0x40C720 (vtable slot 0x8C at 0x47650C, invoked by slot 0x150 = 0x410080) or the 0x40FED0 wrapper (slot 0x14C at 0x4765CC). The word fields are 16-bit tint colors: word[0x7DA061-62] tints the player sprite (0x40FD6E), word[0x7DA063-64] tints the mount sprite (0x40FDB0) and the HUD mount icon (0x44B666 -> 0x45FD50 arg6; proven a fill color for RLE op 0xC2 spans at 0x45FF9F with 565 masks at [ebx+0x67..0x74] and float channel scaling at 0x4600B6). Server-side semantic names of 1/2/3 and the protocol origin of the colors remain candidate.
